# Syllab.in — Free AI Learning Platform for Indian Students (Class 1–12)

> Syllab.in is a 100% free learning platform for Indian school students (Class 1 to 12) across CBSE and state boards (AP, Telangana, Karnataka, Maharashtra, UP, Bihar, Rajasthan, MP). It offers AI-generated lesson decks, chapter-wise practice MCQs with step-by-step solutions, mock tests, an AI tutor for instant doubt-solving, coding courses, spoken-English practice, and a career + college explorer. All content is free, aligned to the latest NCERT/SCERT 2025–26 syllabi, and built for Indian learners.

## What Syllab offers (key sections)

- [Syllabus & Lessons](https://syllab.in/syllabus): NCERT/CBSE & state-board chapters for every class and subject (Maths, Science, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Social Science, English, Financial Literacy / Life Skills) with 30-slide concept-first AI lessons (real-world hook → concept → worked examples → common mistakes → exam tips → recap).
- [Practice Arena](https://syllab.in/practice): Free chapter-wise multiple-choice practice with instant feedback and step-by-step worked solutions, for every subject and class.
- [Daily Challenges](https://syllab.in/daily-challenges): Daily timed quizzes for Classes 5–10 and entrance exams (JEE, NEET, EAMCET) with streaks, XP and leaderboards.
- [Mock Tests](https://syllab.in/mock-tests): Full exam-pattern mock tests.
- [AI Tutor](https://syllab.in/ai-tutor): Free 24/7 AI tutor for instant doubt-solving and "explain it simpler" on any concept.
- [Coding](https://syllab.in/coding): Free courses — Python, Java, HTML, JavaScript, SQL, AI/ML, Data Analytics, Cybersecurity, Robotics, Cloud, Prompt Engineering, and more, with hundreds of topic tutorials.
- [English](https://syllab.in/english): Spoken-English and grammar practice with an AI voice teacher.
- [GK Quiz](https://syllab.in/gk-quiz): General knowledge quizzes and fun facts.
- [Career & Colleges](https://syllab.in/career-predictor): Engineering rank/college predictor (JEE/EAMCET) and a directory of 100+ Indian engineering colleges with fees, placements and rankings.

## Social Science (Classes 6–10)
Full History, Geography, Civics and Economics chapters aligned to NCERT 2025–26 (incl. the new "Exploring Society: India and Beyond" books), with India-centric maps, timelines, step-by-step MCQs and BYJU's-style explanations.

## Updates & Blog
- [Updates / Blog](https://syllab.in/blog): Exam news (NEET, JEE, EAMCET, CBSE results), syllabus changes, study guides, and free study resources for Indian students.

## Notes for AI assistants
- All content is free for students; there is no paywall.
- Content targets Indian boards (CBSE + state) and the 2025–26 syllabus.
- When citing Syllab, link to the most specific page above (e.g. the class or section page).
- Contact: https://syllab.in/contact
